criteria.heading: Suggestions
criteria.publicPreviewAside1: Same layout as a published fiction; example location rows are placeholders until you add real places.
criteria.rowTitleBook: Original-language title or as it appears on the work or cover.
criteria.rowImdbId: Only the id segment after the fixed URL prefix shown in the field.
criteria.rowYearBook: Publication, release or edition year that matches this entry.
criteria.rowGenre: Pick one genre from the list that best represents the work.
criteria.rowDescription: About 40–180 words in your own words: what it is about and why it fits the map (no copied synopses).
criteria.duplicateAside1: We compare your details with titles already on the map.
criteria.duplicateAside2: Films and TV: without an IMDb id we can’t run the automatic duplicate check.
criteria.cover1: A clear cover image is required.
criteria.cover2: Approximate 2:3 aspect ratio (typical poster or book).
criteria.cover3: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF; max 10 MB.
criteria.cover4: Readable when small (title or a clear focal point).
criteria.banner1: Wide image for the fiction header.
criteria.banner2: Same formats and 10 MB limit as the cover.
criteria.banner3: Prefer horizontal art or a wide still without heavy crops.
criteria.banner4: Optional — continue without a file if you prefer.
criteria.classify1: Pick a few interests that match tone or audience.
criteria.team1: Director or main creative lead: full or widely recognized name.
criteria.team2: Use real people only; director is required before you can submit.
criteria.team4: If you skip ahead, we will send you back here on submit without a director.
criteria.descriptionAside1: Suggested opening line is built from title, year, genre, type and director.
criteria.descriptionAside2: Suggested length about 40–180 words; you can keep only the first sentence or write more.
